paragraphs: Every Saturday my sister and I walk to the market near the river.
It opens early, and the best bread is gone by nine.
The man who sells apples knows us.
He always asks about our mother, and he always gives us one more apple than we pay for.
Last week it rained, but the market was full anyway.
People stood under the old bridge with their bags and talked about the weather.
My sister bought flowers for the kitchen table.
I bought cheese, a few tomatoes and a small jar of honey.
On the way home we stopped at a cafe.
The coffee was strong, and the window was warm from the sun that suddenly came out.
Are you coming to the party tonight?

chapters.title: Chapter 1. The Keeper
paragraphs: There was a lighthouse at the end of the road, and an old man lived in it.
Every evening he climbed the stairs and lit the lamp.
The ships saw the light from far away.
They knew where the rocks were, and they went home safely.

chapters.title: Chapter 2. The Storm
paragraphs: One night a storm came from the sea.
The wind was loud, the rain was cold, and the lamp went out.
The old man found a candle in the kitchen.
He carried it up the stairs, slowly, with both hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 3. The Morning
paragraphs: In the morning the sea was quiet again.
A small boat came to the rocks, and a girl jumped out.
"We saw your candle," she said.
"My father is a fisherman.
He is home because of you."
